name: maxio-pp-mcp
description: Open, local revenue-intelligence CLI for Maxio Advanced Billing  -  MRR waterfalls, retention, and per-client history computed offline from a SQLite mirror, so the trended history survives even though the live API returns only point-in-time figures.

maxio_password.title: MAXIO_PASSWORD
maxio_password.description: Sets MAXIO_PASSWORD for the Maxio MCP server. Get a credential from https://app.chargify.com/signup/maxio-billing-sandbox.

maxio_site.title: MAXIO_SITE
maxio_site.description: Sets MAXIO_SITE for the endpoint template variable {site}.

maxio_username.title: MAXIO_USERNAME
maxio_username.description: Sets MAXIO_USERNAME for the Maxio MCP server. Get a credential from https://app.chargify.com/signup/maxio-billing-sandbox.

maxio_api_key.title: Maxio API key
maxio_api_key.description: Single-secret Maxio credential, sent as the HTTP Basic username with the constant 'x' as the password. Use this or the MAXIO_USERNAME + MAXIO_PASSWORD pair.

maxio_base_url.title: Maxio API base URL
maxio_base_url.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds it from MAXIO_SITE. Set it only to point at a different host.
